notes:
BLOCKED on the stop path. Last gate run (python3 -m mhs.driver check MHS/drivers/labs/quantumquadrate__k10cr1 --backend fake) failed only on: G3 fail Strict resolve / error G3.NO_ESTOP: a hardware driver at R1 needs an @estop method (the native stop the runtime calls after it latches). G1, G2, G4 and G7 pass; G5, G6, G8 and G9 are NOT_RUN because G3 failed. Why no honest @estop exists: the upstream class K10CR1.k10cr1:K10CR1 (K10CR1/k10cr1.py:6-189, the whole module is 189 lines) defines exactly __init__, connect, angle_to_DU, DU_to_angle, dth, btd, htb, rd, write, identify, home, moverel, moveabs, zerobacklash, jog and getpos. There is no stop, abort, halt, disable, close or free-run method, and the class never reads the device status or moving state: a move that moverel() or moveabs() started cannot be cancelled through this library (moverel/moveabs only write the frame and do not even read a response, k10cr1.py:154-170). DRV-012 requires the @estop method to reach the real native stop, so any @estop here would either be a no-op or invent the Thorlabs APT stop frame, which the clone does not use and which would be invented wire syntax and an invented fact; both are excluded, so the package is reported blocked instead of faked. The blocked code chosen is HELPER_MISSING because neither the card's SerialDriver nor a direct Driver over the upstream class can express the driver the hardware contract requires; a maintainer decision is needed: skip the card, ask the upstream to add a stop command, or change the contract for devices whose library has no stop. DEVIATION FROM THE CARD: the card proposes a SerialDriver (family serial, family-config), but every command is a hex frame of the Thorlabs APT protocol and each move frame is assembled from a header, a channel word and a 4-byte encoder position (k10cr1.py:154-170), so a command table cannot reproduce it; this package is a direct Driver over the class, and its four move/home/jog capabilities are extension ids (listed in catalogue_requests). Other gaps: identify() only writes the information frame and returns the byte count of serial.write, not an identity (k10cr1.py:147-148), so the driver has no identity check; the clone states no travel limits, velocity or acceleration, so both move inputs are Limit.operator_required and site-limits.example.json supplies an example range; the fake is an in-memory stand-in with placeholder values, not a recording (the clone has no simulator and no hardware was available, so the card's preferred transcript could not be recorded). driver.lock.json reviewed_by is null: the package is model-authored and unreviewed, hardware was never attached, and nothing in it ran on a device.
